segments.transcript: So, context first. I have had Nimbus for quite a bit, since before Atlas even dropped. Atlas, I got nothing early. I subscribed like everyone else, had it for three days before we lost it, waited weeks, and now I have had it back for about a week and a half. And I am very impressed, I will be real. Both of these models are absolutely incredible, and I do substantial compute in token utilization with both, every single day. I have never built as much as I have over the last couple weeks. The community split is real, though. Alex said five six was the best model he had ever used, then Atlas came out and he stopped using five six overnight. Jules, who runs CodeBench, had it the other way: his people had Atlas early, were not that interested, and when five six came back it was immediately clear to them it was way better. They were also stuck running it on medium because of a bug and did not even know. And Morgan was tweeting about missing Atlas when what he actually missed was Nimbus.
